Subject: Help: Ariba registration failing because of MSA redlines / PO format

Hi Kimberly,

We're about to finish vendor onboarding but hit two blockers: (1) our Ariba registration expects a vendor_tax_id and PO number in the format VAL-##### and Redwood's order form has an alternative PO schema; (2) our procurement team flagged a redline in the MSA (Section 7, indemnity + Section 4.2 liability cap) that your legal reviewed but the signed order form must reference the accepted language.

Attached: Current_Ariba_Schema.xlsx with the exact field names. Can we run a short triage with your legal/ops to decide whether to accept the redline or adjust the ported fields in Ariba so the PO will map into our ERP? We have internal sign-off contingent on either (A) Redwood accepts the limited indemnity change or (B) we update the PO mapping and include a contract reference number on every PO.

I'm copying procurement@valencemed.com and Tom Sullivan (legal counsel) — he’ll send the formal redline.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel

Hi Aisha — thanks for the heads up and the schema. We're ready to triage this today. Quick read / proposed path: 

- Legal (Mateo) can review the specific redline to Section 4.2 (liability cap) and Section 7 (indemnity). If Redwood accepts a narrow carve (service-related third-party claims only) we can proceed without a contract amendment. If Valence requires full removal, we will need a signed order form acknowledgement with explicit PO reference before production.
- Ops (Jonas) can map your Current_Ariba_Schema.xlsx to Redwood's PO payload. The two main fields to sync are: vendor_tax_id -> vendorTaxId, and external_po_id -> orderReference. We can add a vendor_metadata.contract_ref field to the Ariba mapping so POs include the MSA version.
- Sales (Marissa) will own the mutual action plan and DocuSign routing.

Can you confirm whether Procurement needs the contract reference to be present on every PO, or if a single Master Contract ID is sufficient? Proposed meeting: 30m at 1:30pm PT today. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short triage checklist.

Action items I’ll start on:
- Jonas: draft mapping table for your Ariba fields
- Mateo: preliminary acceptability check on the redline
- Marissa: set up DocuSign routing and note for legal sign-off deadline

Thanks — we want to avoid rework in the Ariba mapping so our ERP consumes POs cleanly.

Best,
Kimberly Park

Tom / Aisha — thank you. High level legal triage: 

- Liability cap: Redwood's standard is a 12-month fees cap; we are willing to accept a mutual cap at fees paid in prior 12 months but need a carve for fraud/intentional misconduct. We will prepare a redline that marks that carve.
- Consequential damages: Redwood cannot broadly accept removal; propose narrowing the exclusion to loss of third-party data resulting from Redwood's gross negligence.
- PO reference: Ops asks that procurement include the contract reference in external_po_id (we can map CONTRACT-VAL-2025 -> vendor_metadata.contract_ref). That satisfies downstream ERP reconciliation.

I’ve attached a short summary of acceptable edits and a redline snippet in redline_summary.txt. If Valence agrees to the limited fraud carve, we can proceed to DocuSign and do a parallel Ariba field mapping (Jonas to action).

Next steps (proposed):
- Legal alignment: agree on limited fraud carve + mutual 12-month cap (deadline EOD 6/16)
- Ops mapping: Jonas to deliver the Ariba->Redwood mapping by 6/16 morning
- Sales: Marissa to create a mutual action plan and route DocuSign for signature once redline agreed

Cheers,
